notes: Day 28 (St. Martianus & St. Marcian / ቅዱሳን መርትያኖስ ወመርቅያን) continues from page 107: opens with ¶፪ ('ጳጳሳት ዘቍስጥንጥንያ ውእቱኑ...'), ¶፫ martyrdom and burial until St. John Chrysostom translated their relics to Constantinople, ¶፬ doxology, Arke hymn ('ሰላም ለመርትያኖስ ዘተጋደለ በጽንዐ...'). Commemoration ¶፭ of Abba Mekbyu, Abba Yem'ata (2 of the 9 Saints), Japheth blessed by Noah, and the Patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Line-by-line verified against page_108.png. 2026-11-04: re-checked against scan; names (መርቆሬዎስ), arke and wording fixed.
